sections.Profile:
The "Big Day" pinball machine, released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in August 1964, is a four-player, electro-mechanical game with a celebration theme. Designed by Ted Zale, it features two flippers, three pop bumpers, six mushroom bumpers, and two slingshots.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1964
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
